errors.evidence: The description uses the word "височина" (height) to describe the dimension of the bars that represents value. However, the chart is a horizontal bar chart, where value is represented by the length ("дължина") of the bars, not their height. This contradicts the correct statement that the categories are on the vertical axis, which implies horizontal bars.

The description uses the phrase "Най-високият стълб" (The highest bar). For a horizontal bar chart, the correct term would be "Най-дългият стълб" (The longest bar). This is an error in describing the structure of the chart.
